brynn: tiny wording nit  say \"per-token inference cost" and keep the \"up to\" qualifier. Also let's call out the workload class in the line like you did.

rahul: PM check  LGTM pending legal. Adding demo repo link in the post.

legal-bot: Automated scan: flagged absolute numeric phrasing. Recommend adding methodology line (you have it) and avoiding standalone superlatives. Manual review required for "up to 2.9x" and numeric latency claim; legal ops will respond in-thread within 48h.

brynn: noted. we should prepare the methods appendix and a condensed note for the post that links out to the public notebook.

nicole: next steps: 1) legal quick-pass, 2) finalize hero image + GIF trace, 3) lock UTMs + utm_ab flags, 4) schedule embargo/publish window. please ack.
